import java.util.Scanner;

public class EmailProcessor {
    public static String processEmail(String emailInput) {
        int atIndex = emailInput.indexOf("at", 1);
        if (atIndex != -1) {
            emailInput = emailInput.substring(0, atIndex) + "@" + emailInput.substring(atIndex + 2);
        }
        int dotIndex = emailInput.indexOf("dot", 1);
        while (dotIndex != -1 && emailInput.length() != dotIndex + 3) {
            emailInput = emailInput.substring(0, dotIndex) + "." + emailInput.substring(dotIndex + 3);
            dotIndex = emailInput.indexOf("dot", 1);
        }
        return emailInput;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String email = scanner.next();
        System.out.println(processEmail(email));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
